content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Students who had completed BSc in Agriculture/Zoology/Life Sciences; or completed/pursuing post graduate degree in Agricultural Entomology/Zoology/Life Sciences Other conditions: Applicants must provide an active email ID and mobile number in the application Desirable: Candidates with research aptitude for insect collection and insect taxonomy

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Internship is only for two months and ends after completion of two months from the date of joining No other claim will be made by the student Intern will submit data books, data and a work report at completion of internship

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Student Internship.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 5000 per month (consolidated), as per norms of DST-ANRF.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Students who had completed BSc in Agriculture/Zoology/Life Sciences or completed/pursuing post graduate degree in Agricultural Entomology/Zoology/Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must provide an active email ID and mobile number in the application.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Online interview. Shortlisted students will be called for an online interview. Candidates will be informed of the interview via email.

faq.answer: Internship is only for two months and ends after completion of two months from the date of joining. No other claim will be made by the student. Intern will submit data books, data and a work report at completion of internship.

faq.answer: Designated lab at ICAR-NBAIR, Bengaluru.
